claim(uint256,bytes32[]).details: Reverts with `ERC20InsufficientBalance` if the caller has not yet claimed enough K613S1 from `K613S1Distributor` to cover the payout.

params.totalAllocation: Total K613 the caller is authorised to receive across the full vesting period.

params._admin: Address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `PAUSER_ROLE` (typically the governance Safe).
params._k613: Address of the K613 token (transferred out on claim).
params._k613s1: Address of the K613S1 token (burned 1:1 on claim). This contract must be granted `K613S1.BURNER_ROLE` post-deployment.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

BPS_DENOMINATOR().notice: Basis-points denominator used for the vesting schedule (10_000 = 100%).

CLAIM_WINDOW().notice: Length of the claim window after TGE. After this, claims revert and governance can recover unclaimed K613.

claim(uint256,bytes32[]).notice: Claims the vested portion of caller's allocation. Burns K613S1 1:1 and transfers K613.

claimDeadline().notice: Timestamp after which claims revert and governance can recover. Equals `tgeTimestamp + CLAIM_WINDOW`.

claimed(address).notice: Cumulative K613 paid to each user. Equals cumulative K613S1 burned from them.

k613().notice: K613 token paid out to claimers on the vesting schedule.

k613s1().notice: K613S1 token burned 1:1 with K613 paid out.

merkleRoot().notice: Final Merkle root over `keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(account, totalAllocation))))` leaves.

recoverUnclaimedK613(address,uint256).notice: After `claimDeadline`, governance recovers any K613 still held by the contract (unclaimed allocations + accidental sends). Only callable by `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.

tgeTimestamp().notice: TGE timestamp. Vesting curve is anchored here.

vestedFraction(uint256).notice: Returns the vested fraction of an allocation at timestamp `ts`, in basis points (`BPS_DENOMINATOR` = 100%). Step schedule: 0% pre-TGE, 20% at TGE, +20% every 15 days, 100% at TGE+60 days.
